module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-add multiplier: load latches operands, each go step adds the shifted multiplicand gated by multiplier LSB into an accumulator; a step counter flags completion.

anchors.name: sum
anchors.why: Product accumulator, cleared on load, adds partial product each step; module result.

anchors.name: mcand
anchors.why: Multiplicand latched from ia, shifted left each step.

anchors.name: mplier
anchors.why: Multiplier latched from ib, shifted right; LSB gates the addend.

anchors.name: lap
anchors.why: Step counter cleared on load, incremented per go; reaching 16 raises last.

anchors.name: addend
anchors.why: Partial product: multiplicand gated by multiplier LSB.

anchors.name: ld
anchors.why: Load command: latches operands, clears accumulator and counter.

anchors.name: go
anchors.why: Step enable: performs one shift-add iteration and counts it.

anchors.name: last
anchors.why: Completion indication when step counter reaches 16.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand shift registers, gated partial product and accumulator.

groups.name: step_counter
groups.description: Counts go steps after load and signals completion at 16.
